gloss: rather small; on the small side; smallish

definitions.gloss: rather small; on the small side; smallish
definitions.explanation: Slightly smaller than average or expected, without being extremely small.

examples.japanese: {小|ちい}さめ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦サイズ→サイズ：01363_saizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please give me the smaller size.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦シャツ→シャツ：01052_shatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{小|ちい}さめ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{作|つく}られている→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: This shirt is made on the small side.

examples.japanese: ⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{小|ちい}さめ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦バッグ→バッグ：00008_baggu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{入|はい}り→入る：00494_hairu⟧きらない⟦かもしれない→かもしれない：00164_kamoshirenai⟧。
examples.english: Since I have a lot of luggage, a smallish bag might not fit everything.

notes:
Formed by adding the suffix ～め to the adjective stem {小|ちい}さ. The ～め suffix indicates "somewhat" or "leaning toward" a quality, softening the adjective. This is a productive pattern in Japanese that works with many adjectives.

USAGE:
- Modifies nouns with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: {小|ちい}さめ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun
- Can also be used adverbially with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: {小|ちい}さめ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧ (to cut somewhat small)
- Very common in shopping, cooking, and describing physical dimensions
- The ～め pattern works with other adjectives too: ⟦{大|おお}きめ→大きめ：21239_ookime⟧ (on the large side), ⟦{長|なが}め→長め：14550_nagame⟧ (on the long side), ⟦{早|はや}め→早め：11176_hayame⟧ (on the early side)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {小|ちい}さめ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦サイズ→サイズ：01363_saizu⟧: a smaller size
- {小|ちい}さめ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧: to cut rather small
- {小|ちい}さめ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧: a smallish room
- ⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧{小|ちい}さめ: a little on the small side

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{小|ちい}さい→小さい：00025_chiisai⟧: small — the base adjective; states the size directly without hedging
- ⟦やや→やや：03642_yaya⟧⟦{小|ちい}さい→小さい：00025_chiisai⟧: slightly small — similar meaning expressed with an adverb
- ⟦{大|おお}きめ→大きめ：21239_ookime⟧: on the large side — the opposite pattern using ⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧
- ⟦コンパクト→コンパクト：10862_konpakuto⟧な: compact — loanword; implies small but well-designed
